findings.note: Registry processing is not bound to one fixed snapshot as REQ-001 requires. The resolver parses the discovered Registry, the validator independently re-reads its path, and generate-registry-digest independently rediscovers and reads it without receiving the located path or retained bytes. A Registry change between these operations can therefore make capability evaluations use the old document while validation and context_binding.registry_digest describe newer bytes; the later recheck can still pass if the newer bytes remain stable. This silent mixed-generation provenance defect is acknowledged as unresolved in the implementation report and lacks a fixture for the step-5-to-step-6 race.

The required traceability evidence remains stale after the reported recapture: it claims six T-003 fixtures and focused-test totals of 102, while the current contract/report and focused logs describe eleven fixtures and 155 passing assertions. The manual evidence therefore does not accurately verify the reviewed tree.
